## Request Context
- **What was requested**: Pre-commit code review of Telemetry Layer A1 (per-tier dollar cost + coverage% over the existing capture stack).
- **Files/scope**: scripts/init_db.py (2 new tables), src/telemetry/{pricing,cost}.py (pure), scripts/telemetry/analyze_cost.py (transport), tests/test_telemetry.py (27 tests), docs/adr/ADR-0020 (new) + ADR-0013 (ratified accepted), regression-ledger entry.
- **Developer-stated motivation**: telemetry captured but invisible + no per-tier cost; A1 fills the cost gap (live smoke test: $655.83 / 264.9M tok, 100% coverage).
- **Explicit constraints**: compute-don't-store (no dollar persisted); reuse ingest_token_usage parser; tier-unknown marked never zero-rated; coverage% on token denominator; watermark+--full-rescan idempotent. Already spec-reviewed (4 specialists) + Steward APPROVE + build checkpoint (arch+security APPROVE). Verify 3 carried advisories: private-helper coupling, INSERT-clarity (fixed), init_db f-string DDL.

1 BLOCKING + 4 advisory (0.87). BLOCKING: watermark equality boundary - _target_discussion_ids used strict closed_dt > wm, so a NEW discussion closing at the exact same timestamp as the watermark would be silently skipped forever (recoverable only via --full-rescan); behavior was untested. ADVISORY: weak assertion in test_analyze_unknown_model_marked_not_dropped (assert <100 vs precise ~90); missing adjacent-window attribution test; missing two-discussion per-model granularity test; coverage rounding untested. STRENGTHS: no live ~/.claude reads; pytest.approx for float math; idempotency+dry-run first-class; SQL injection test asserts stored value not just no-raise; migration tests PRAGMA-assert columns; regression-ledger entry present.

No blocking (0.88). Private-helper coupling (analyze_cost uses ingest_token_usage _parse_timestamp/_attribute/_collect_messages/_load_discussion_windows) = ACCEPTABLE-WITH-ADVISORY not blocking (Rule of Three: 2 in-tree co-owned consumers; cheap guard = a contract test asserting the symbols/signatures; promote to public on a 3rd consumer). DELETE-then-plain-INSERT confirmed correct + the better choice (fails loud). Per-discussion-per-model deviation from turns.model_id is sound + adequately documented in ADR-0020 (Alt 1). src->scripts dependency direction correct (transport depends on pure core). init_db print side-effect on already-exists path = optional cosmetic cleanup. f-string DDL advisory does NOT apply to the new tables (static executescript). ADR provenance hygiene (ratify 0013 before amending) praised.

No blocking (0.92). Narrow local threat surface, handled cleanly. VERIFIED SAFE: parameterized SQL throughout (every execute uses ? placeholders); path traversal delegated to ingest_token_usage _is_inside_projects_root (analyze_cost walks nothing itself); yaml.safe_load + 3-layer defensive degradation; untrusted model_id never surfaced to prompt/ntfy/eval sink (only resolved tier printed); no raw DB error exposure; FK PRAGMA on. ADVISORY: (1) pre-existing f-string DDL in init_db _migrations - safe today (hardcoded literals; SQLite forbids ? in DDL identifiers) - add allowlist assert as future-proofing, non-blocking; (2) pyyaml >=6.0 not exact-pinned (Rule 20) - low, pre-existing, project-wide >= convention; (3) test PRAGMA f-string informational. SQL injection regression test confirmed meaningful.

No blocking (0.91). KEY: the watermark prevents re-WRITING already-analyzed discussions but NOT re-READING the full transcript corpus - _collect_messages parses all 430MB/1429 files every run regardless of watermark (5-20s today, dominant cost at 10x). MEDIUM advisory: add a session-file mtime watermark (stat per file, skip unparsed) - cheapest fix; carry to A2/follow-up. LOW: _attribute is O(M*D) linear window scan - fine now (newest-first early-exit), revisit with an interval tree if discussions >300; row-by-row writes are fine in a single WAL transaction. STRENGTHS: build_cost_report genuinely single-pass; load_cost_rows scoped to the small derived table; index coverage correct; watermark written only after successful commit (no partial-run advance).

Finding verification: 1 blocking verified real (watermark same-timestamp silent-skip in _target_discussion_ids) and FIXED in-session via a not-yet-analyzed backstop (_analyzed_discussion_ids) + regression test test_target_selection_includes_unanalyzed_discussion_at_watermark. qa weak-assertion advisory FIXED (precise ~90 coverage assert). All security 'verified safe' items confirmed against code. No findings discarded as false.

## Request Context
- **What was requested**: Pre-commit code review of Telemetry Layer A1 (per-tier dollar cost + coverage%).
- **Files/scope**: scripts/init_db.py, src/telemetry/{pricing,cost}.py, scripts/telemetry/analyze_cost.py, tests/test_telemetry.py, docs/adr/ADR-0020 + ADR-0013, regression-ledger.
- **Developer-stated motivation**: fill the per-tier cost visibility gap.
- **Explicit constraints**: compute-don't-store; reuse parser; tier-unknown never zero-rated; coverage% token-denominator; watermark idempotent.

## Synthesis
VERDICT: APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES (blocking resolved in-session). Panel: qa-specialist:sonnet(0.87), architecture-consultant:opus(0.88), security-specialist:opus(0.92), performance-analyst:opus(0.91). 1 BLOCKING + 11 advisory.
BLOCKING (qa, verified, FIXED): watermark same-timestamp silent-skip in _target_discussion_ids (strict > would orphan a new discussion closing at the watermark instant). Fixed with a not-yet-analyzed backstop (_analyzed_discussion_ids: a closed discussion with no breakdown rows is always a target) + regression test. 28 tests pass, quality gate 7/7.
ADVISORY (carried, non-blocking): (perf, notable) watermark gates re-WRITE not re-READ - _collect_messages parses all 430MB every run; fix = session-file mtime watermark (-> A2/follow-up). (arch) private-helper coupling on ingest_token_usage - Rule-of-Three: add contract test, promote on 3rd consumer. (security) init_db pre-existing f-string DDL allowlist; pyyaml >= vs exact pin (project-wide >= convention, pre-existing). (qa) adjacent-window + two-discussion granularity + coverage-rounding tests. (arch) init_db print side-effect cosmetic.
Confidence annotation: 0 findings <0.80; 0 unscored. Model tiers: qa-specialist:sonnet, architecture-consultant:opus, security-specialist:opus, performance-analyst:opus.
Strong consensus the implementation is sound: clean pure/transport boundary, honest unknown-tier sentinel, parameterized SQL, reused traversal guard, compute-don't-store verified, ADR provenance hygiene praised.
